title: Editor asks Avi Loeb to cut alien paragraph from 3I/ATLAS paper

tellings.quote: he said, he was telling this on a Zoom meeting. The journal editor goes, "Okay, this is a great paper, but you have to take out the final paragraph."

plain: A journal editor told the astronomer Avi Loeb that his 2025 paper on 3I/ATLAS, an object passing through the solar system from interstellar space, was great but that he had to take out the final paragraph, the one raising the idea that it might be alien. The well-known skeptic Michael Shermer tells this to Michels, saying Loeb described it himself on a Zoom meeting. It is told as an example of journals keeping the alien question out of print.
